Text:
A new week is underway for Shelby County schools, with football, volleyball, and cross country all on the calendar.

Center, Joaquin, Tenaha, Timpson, and Shelbyville each have something worth following this week. The individual cards have the details—from the Roughriders at the Whitehouse volleyball tournament to the Rams and Tigers meeting Friday, along with Bears and Dragons road games.

Good luck to every student-athlete, coach, band member, and family making these school nights happen. We will be cheering for all five schools.
